Retailer page fixtures for the offline parser tests in
`tests/test_retail_adapters.py`.

Each file reproduces the structure of a page as recorded from the shop on
2026-11-17 (the product data blocks, prices, names, stock flags and
impedance lines), cut down to two or three products. Descriptions, images,
scripts and navigation were removed, and some products and values were
changed to cover test cases, so the prices here are not real offers.
